# Docifice

> Docifice is a technical writing agency with more than 11 years of experience documenting software products. We offer end-to-end documentation, embedded technical writers and technical recruitment.

## Ways to engage
- [End-to-end documentation](https://docifice.com/ways-to-engage/managed-documentation): a team that plans, writes, reviews and maintains your documentation
- [Embedded technical writers](https://docifice.com/ways-to-engage/embedded-writers): writers who join your team and work in your tools and sprints
- [Technical recruitment](https://docifice.com/ways-to-engage/technical-recruitment): sourcing and assessing technical writers and documentation engineers

## Services
- [Technical documentation](https://docifice.com/services/technical-documentation)
- [API and developer documentation](https://docifice.com/services/api-documentation)
- [Documentation engineering (docs-as-code)](https://docifice.com/services/documentation-engineering)
- [Content strategy and design](https://docifice.com/services/content-strategy)
- [Knowledge management](https://docifice.com/services/knowledge-management)
- [Training and enablement](https://docifice.com/services/training-enablement)
- [AI-ready documentation](https://docifice.com/services/ai-ready-documentation)
- [AI search optimization](https://docifice.com/services/ai-search-optimization)
